result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. The presence of a large utility pole on the corner sidewalk and the absence of traffic calming measures like curb extensions reduce the overall safety and comfort for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no visible pedestrian signal heads, forcing walkers to rely on vehicle traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is located on the corner sidewalk, narrowing the path for pedestrians and those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: On the sidewalk corner in front of the green building.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signals within a mixed-use commercial environment. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of refuge islands or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of roadway without a midway refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner may block sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the corner building

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position for drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps adjacent to a church and residential buildings. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a median refuge or curb extensions to shorten the exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light to increase visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and a traffic signal, providing basic infrastructure for pedestrians. However, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions, leaving pedestrians exposed to turning traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
